data.body:
Autonomous RP-01 derisk update (research only; no production edits). The offline Pydantic AI 1.107.2 harness now reports 32 declared observations. Successful-retry comparison: current manual prompted retry made two calls with output tokens [5,7] but returned `_usage.requests=1` / `output_tokens=7`; the same-run Pydantic retry returned `requests=2` / `output_tokens=12`. Historical tickets `puerile-defensive-nighthawk` and `strange-gargantuan-norwayrat` require actual consumption/spend without double-counting, and the test contract is one durable row per runner operation, not accepted-attempt-only numbers. Recommendation: intentionally adopt aggregate operation usage everywhere the successful operation is reported.

Exhaustion translation: Pydantic raises broad `UnexpectedModelBehavior`, also used for unrelated agent defects. In 1.107.2 the final retry cause is retained. Validation exhaustion produced `UnexpectedModelBehavior -> ToolRetryError -> ModelRetry -> StructuredOutputError`; repeated output-size exhaustion produced the same chain ending in `UnretryableOutputError`. A cause-based adapter restored the exact Rebar type, while an unrelated `UnexpectedModelBehavior` was not translated. Recommendation: translate only a Rebar-owned output error found in the cause chain; never blanket-map the upstream class.

Underlying-attempt accounting: 503->fallback and native->prompted each made two logical candidate requests while `RunUsage.requests==1`; all-candidate failure made two while exception-time upstream requests were 0. A narrow wrapper using Pydantic’s public `WrapperModel` around each already-built candidate observed ordered raised/returned outcomes while forwarding identity, lifecycle, request preparation, and count_tokens. Recommendation: keep `requests` as the Agent/request-limit counter and add `candidate_requests` (logical candidate calls, explicitly not hidden SDK/transport retries) to sanitized diagnostics and durable operation rows; do not invent unreported token spend.

Verification: `rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py tests/unit/test_usage_log_failed_calls.py tests/unit/test_usage_log_run_shape_aec1.py tests/unit/test_interpret_failure_seam.py tests/unit/test_llm_failure_matrix.py tests/unit/test_runner_hardening.py tests/unit/test_llm_fallback_chain.py tests/unit/test_runner_pydantic_budget.py` -> 128 passed, 1 existing Pydantic event-loop deprecation warning. Updated ignored artifacts: `.joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-probe.py`, `.joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-research.md`, `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md`. Remaining status: three recommendations await one-at-a-time maintainer approval before RP-01 ticketization.
